odia: ବଡ଼ ଘର ଦେଖି ବନ୍ଧୁ କଲି ଝିଅକୁ ନେଇ ଯମକୁ ଦେଲି
title: An alliance regretted
literal_meaning: Seeing a great household, I made a kinship alliance; I took my daughter and gave her to Yama.
explanation: The dictionary defines the great household by wealth and standing. The speaker’s first-person account turns that attraction into the terrible image of giving a daughter to Yama. Our reading hears regret over judging an alliance by status. The image does not establish an actual death, a particular form of harm or a story about every wealthy family.
meaning_odia: ଅଭିଧାନ “ବଡ଼ ଘର”କୁ ଧନ ଓ ପ୍ରତିଷ୍ଠାରେ ଚିହ୍ନାଏ। ବକ୍ତାର ନିଜ କଥାରେ ସେ ଆକର୍ଷଣ ଝିଅକୁ ଯମ ହାତରେ ଦେବାର ଭୟଙ୍କର ଛବିକୁ ଫେରେ। ଆମ ପଢ଼ାରେ ମର୍ଯ୍ୟାଦା ଦେଖି ବନ୍ଧୁତା ବିଚାର କରିଥିବାର ଅନୁତାପ ଶୁଣାଯାଏ। ଏହି ଛବି ପ୍ରକୃତ ମୃତ୍ୟୁ, ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ କ୍ଷତି ବା ସବୁ ଧନୀ ପରିବାରର କାହାଣୀ ସ୍ଥାପନ କରେନାହିଁ।
english_summary: Our reading hears regret when family prestige becomes the basis of an alliance.
odia_summary: ପରିବାରର ପ୍ରତିଷ୍ଠାକୁ ବନ୍ଧୁତାର ଆଧାର କରିବାର ଅନୁତାପ ଆମ ପଢ଼ାରେ ଶୁଣାଯାଏ।
usage_example: Original imagined example: ପଢ଼ାଚକ୍ରରେ ଜଣେ କହିଲେ, “ଏହାକୁ ଧନୀ ଘର ଖରାପ ବୋଲି ପଢ଼ିବା?” ଅନ୍ୟଜଣ କହିଲେ, “ମୁଁ ବରଂ କେବଳ ପ୍ରତିଷ୍ଠା ଦେଖି ବିଚାର କରିବାର ଅନୁତାପ ପଢ଼ୁଛି।” / A reader asks whether the line condemns wealthy households. Another replies, “I read regret about judging by prestige alone.” This critical discussion is invented.
cultural_context: The daughter and kinship language suggest a marriage alliance; no marriage event, dowry account or abuse history is supplied. Yama is retained as the source’s death image.
